rows: group c9 is the title panels (word order c9t1, subsets c9t2 and c9t3, stop words and punctuation c9t4, synthetic words) and nickname panels c9n1 to c9n5 of this run; group b3 is tt1 and tt2 from the B3 run (2026-11-14, Contact N3Title, same method)

groups f1 and f1s: two later captures, 2026-11-16 UTC, Salesforce CLI 2.156.8, each in its own fresh 30-day Developer Edition scratch org on a campaign Dev Hub, deleted after its run and verified (active hub record 1 -> 0, the local target no longer resolves). Before each org existed the generated sources passed glade parse and check and the branch build's prediction was frozen. Same probe, APIs, routes and repeats; a three-value canary ran before and after the cases (16 observations per stage, 0 failed); all eight observations of each case agree. First capture: f1s1 (standard Contact rule as a fresh org has it: Dave, David, Davy, Sandy, Xander and Marjorie, Peggy under one last name and email address), then the standard rules deactivated and N1Title active: f1t1 (stop words and "it": titles of stop words alone, one content word with stop words), f1t2 (one content word against its prefix and plural), f1t3 (dots, ampersands and commas inside a word). Second capture, N1Title: f2t1 (a comma or semicolon after the first word against the plural), f2t2 (stop-word overlap in titles of one to five words).
residuals.tsv: the f1 pairs Glade does not reproduce, native and Glade confidence ("-" is no match). None is a Glade match native does not report: 24 are "A B C" against a title with a word starting with one of its letters (native 93, Glade no match), 9 differ by one or two points of confidence.
